image_description: A large white airship (dirigible) with a dark stripe and gold 'Zeppelin' lettering floats low over a grassy field. A gondola is suspended beneath the hull. In the background, there is another smaller orange balloon/airship, trees, and a blue sky with clouds.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated cigar-shaped craft with exceptionally streamlined envelope.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The main subject clearly exhibits the classic elongated, streamlined cigar shape typical of an airship.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Bilateral symmetry with distinctive elongated oval silhouette much longer than wide.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the airship shows strong bilateral symmetry and the correct aspect ratio (length vs width).

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tapers to pointed nose and conical tail with cruciform or X-shaped fins.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While the nose tapers correctly, the tail structure appears to be a single vertical stabilizer rather than the complex cruciform/X-shaped fin assembly described in the taxonomy. The horizontal stabilizers are not clearly visible or defined as cruciform.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Gondola or car suspended beneath forward section housing crew cabin and engines.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct gondola structure is visible suspended beneath the front-middle section of the hull.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Propeller nacelles mounted on sides or beneath envelope.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No distinct propeller nacelles are clearly visible on the sides or beneath the envelope in this view; they may be occluded or missing from the generation.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Gas-filled hull with stability fins at tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The hull appears gas-filled (buoyant) and has at least one visible vertical stability fin at the tail.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Envelope surface typically silver white or painted with advertising.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The envelope is white with a dark stripe and prominent gold lettering/advertising ('Zeppelin').

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Smooth tapered hull with pointed nose cone.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The hull surface appears smooth and the nose tapers to a point as expected.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Cruciform or X-shaped tail fins for stability.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Similar to the geometry checkpoint, the tail fins do not clearly exhibit the cruciform/X-shape; only a vertical fin is distinctly visible.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The gold lettering reads something like 'Zepelin' or 'Zeppeln' with slightly distorted character shapes and spacing, typical of AI text generation struggles, though it is legible enough to identify the intent.
The tail fins appear somewhat simplified and lack the rigid structural definition of real airship empennage, appearing slightly soft or fused with the hull.
The smaller orange object in the background has an ambiguous shape and connection to the ground/tether, appearing slightly warped.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of airship (Zeppelin-style) and verify class alignment against ImageNet standards.
To rigorously evaluate the legibility and correctness of the 'Zeppelin' text, which showed minor distortion.
To check for edge bleeding between the hull and sky, and to verify the structural integrity of the tail fins.
To ensure the airship is correctly positioned in 3D space relative to the ground and background elements.

focus_areas: Text legibility and spelling accuracy on the hull
Structural correctness of the tail fins (cruciform vs simple)
Presence and detail of propeller nacelles
Edge sharpness between hull and sky
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the tail fin structure; real Zeppelins have complex cruciform tails, while AI often simplifies this to a single fin. Also, scrutinize the text for subtle character deformations beyond just spelling.
